## Delivered

- **`scripts/ci/history_scan.py` — `sig.history-scan/1`.** Walks every
  blob advertised under the public ref surface
  (`refs/remotes/{origin,pull}` + `refs/tags` — what `git ls-remote`
  advertises), reusing `secret_scan.py`'s rule set verbatim plus
  credential-shaped paths, e-mail-shaped literals, and the gitignored
  P34.18 restricted handle list. Reports rule + path + **sha256 of the
  matched literal**, never the bytes. E-mail tokens are classified by
  deterministic shape (robot aliases, RFC-2606/example domains,
  file-suffix false positives, GCP service-account *identifiers*, the
  project's own aliases); a token no class nor disposition covers
  blocks. Value-shape exemptions carve out non-credentials the source
  scanner's `secrets = {…}` exemption can't see in prose: `sig-*`
  Secret Manager *names*, shell templates/commands (`$VAR`, `$(…)`,
  `${…}` anywhere). Path candidates with a content predicate
  (`service-account*.json` needs a `private_key` field — a listing is
  not a key) resolve during the blob pass.
- **`docs/build/reports/p37.55-archival-deposits/`** — the committed
  evidence set: `history_scan.json` (the report), `history_scan_dispositions.toml`
  (`sig.history-scan-dispositions/1` — every finding class mapped to
  `exempt` or `disclosed` with justification; a stale entry fails the
  report), `README.md` (classes + operator handoff). The reviewer-only
  token list lives at `docs/build/logs/history-scan-emails.txt`
  (gitignored — never committed).
- **The scan result, honestly.** 3,530 commits / 27,461 blobs /
  ~4.71 GB over 1,044 public refs: `disposition: clean` — zero
  undisposed findings. Recorded classes: 13,048 handle-token hits over
  the 32 disclosed P34.18 tokens (the disclosed class — retained
  history, never rewritten); 195 distinct e-mail-shaped tokens, all
  classified or dispositioned; the AWS documentation example key in
  test fixtures (exempt); a Google Maps browser key in a scraped
  fixture — public-in-page by design, the tip already carries the
  `REDACTED-` placeholder (disclosed); `SIG_*` credential-shaped
  literals all resolved as Secret Manager names or shell templates,
  never values; service-account `.json` files are listings, not keys
  (content predicate). Dispositions carry `decided_by: agent-analysis
  P37.55 — confirm in the verbatim go` — the operator confirms the
  judgments when they give the go; the machinery is what is gated.
- **`ops/src/ops/swh.py` + `sig-ops swh-save`.** `--repo-url` now
  defaults to the repo's `origin` remote (SSH → HTTPS normalised, the
  public repo since E1 NEW-14), then `SIG_REPO_URL`. `--now` requires
  `--scan-report` naming a `sig.history-scan/1` report with
  `disposition: clean` — absent or red → exit 4, nothing submitted
  (the Q-E2-23 ordering is code, not a memo). Dry-run still prints the
  request JSON and stays untriggered; `submit()` keeps the injectable
  transport and is only ever called behind `--now` + the clean scan.
- **`exports/src/exports/deposit_package.py` + `sig-exports
  deposit-package` — `sig.deposit-package/1`.** Assembles the
  gated Zenodo production package **allow-list, fail-closed**: only the
  `licenses.toml` compartments declared under a real open licence (the
  CC/OGL/ODL family incl. the open-data `LicenseRef`s) plus `metadata`
  ship. Excluded: `operator_accepted`/`public_record` by compartment
  name AND licence token (a combined-licence surface cannot slip
  through), `derived_facts` (a publication basis, not an open
  licence), `web` (derived view indexes), `evidence*` bytes (§38.2 —
  their digests ride `digests.json`). Every included byte must hash to
  the manifest's recorded digest — a stale export refuses the build.
  Emits the filtered `manifest.json`, `digests.json` (all artifacts,
  excluded lanes pinned), the Zenodo `metadata` block, the
  `deposit-package.json` descriptor, and the OP-19 README.
- **`sig-exports deposit --production`.** A gated production path
  behind `SIG_ZENODO_TOKEN` + OP-19 — absent the token, exit 4
  ("gate pending: OP-19"), nothing written; mutually exclusive with
  `--sandbox`. No production call was made; `10.5072` sandbox DOIs are
  never citable as the production concept DOI (RISK-P21-08).
- **RETURN PASS** — `return_pass.toml` `P37.55` `kind = "leg"` with two
  `[[row.legs]]`: `P37.55-swh-save-now` (verbatim go + clean report →
  `sig-ops swh-save --now --scan-report <report>`) and
  `P37.55-zenodo-publish` (verbatim go → the OP-19 manual publish);
  `return_pass.py generate` + `check` green; `current_projection`
  regenerated + verified.
- **Tests** — `tests/unit/test_history_scan.py` (14: history-not-tip
  finding, disclosed vs blocking classes, disposition exempt/disclosed/
  stale, value-shape and predicate exemptions, no-echo, CLI exits);
